name: How long does professional black mold removal take?

mainEntity.name: How long does professional black mold removal take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of black mold removal varies significantly depending on the size of the infestation, the type of materials affected, and the underlying moisture problem. A smaller, contained issue might take 1-3 days, including drying time. More extensive mold growth, especially in multiple areas or requiring significant structural drying and repairs, could take a week or longer. A professional assessment is needed to provide a more accurate timeline, as each situation is unique.
acceptedAnswer.description: The time for black mold removal depends on the infestation's size and complexity. Smaller issues might take 1-3 days, while larger ones could take a week or more.
